modules.title: API Key 放在环境变量里还是写在代码里

items.title: 程序版的门禁卡
items.text: 你的网页调用 AI 服务时，请求里带上这串字符，服务验证它所属的账户、项目或应用，再按对应权限处理请求和记录用量。

items.title: 在服务商后台创建
items.text: 去提供服务的网站（比如 AI 服务商）创建 Key，通常只在创建时完整显示一次，要当场保存好。

items.title: 泄露就吊销
items.text: 发现 Key 出现在不该出现的地方，第一件事是回后台吊销它，再创建新的——比追查谁看到过更快更稳。

modules.title: 容易混淆的地方
modules.text: API Key 和 Auth Token 都可能用于程序鉴权，具体名称、有效期和权限范围由服务决定，不能只看名字判断它是否短期或安全。它们都不该出现在代码仓库或聊天记录中；与 AI 协作时可以说「Key 从环境变量读取，只引用变量名」。

lessonPractice.title: AI 把 API Key 直接写在了代码里，正确的处理方式是？

options.label: 移到环境变量里，代码只引用变量名
options.feedback: 对。环境变量存在部署平台或本地的配置里，不进代码仓库；代码里只写变量名，Key 的值不上传。

options.label: 没关系，项目是私有的，放着就行
options.feedback: 私有仓库也可能被泄漏、被截图、被 AI 工具读到；Key 写在代码里迟早会跟着代码一起离开你的控制。

options.label: 发给协作的同事，让大家填在各自代码里
options.feedback: Key 应该各自创建、按人管理；散落在聊天记录和多个代码库里更难吊销。

en.title: The AI hardcoded your API Key in the source. What is the right fix?

options.label: Move it to an environment variable; reference the variable name in code
options.feedback: Correct. Env vars live on the deploy platform or local config, never in the repo; code carries only the name, not the value.

options.label: It's a private repo, just leave it
options.feedback: Private repos leak, get screenshotted, and get read by AI tooling; a key in code eventually escapes your control.

options.label: Send it to teammates so everyone pastes it into their code
options.feedback: Keys should be created per person and per environment; copies in chats and repos are hard to revoke.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: API Key 通过环境变量读取，变量名用 AI_API_KEY；代码和示例里都不要出现真实 Key。如果发现 Key 被写进了代码，提醒我，我去后台吊销换新的。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Read the API key from an environment variable named AI_API_KEY; never put the real key in code or examples. If you spot a key hardcoded somewhere, tell me so I can revoke and rotate it.

references.title: API Key 安全最佳实践

learning.assumes: You have signed up for a website account and know services charge by usage.
learning.outcome: You keep keys in env vars out of the repo, know to revoke and rotate on leak, and understand when the AI says "configure an API key first."

modules.title: Same key, right place versus wrong place

items.title: A badge for programs
items.text: Your page sends the string with an AI request. The service verifies its account, project, or application, then applies the corresponding permissions and usage tracking.

items.title: Created in the provider console
items.text: Create the key on the service's website; it usually displays fully only once at creation, so save it right away.

items.title: Revoke on leak
items.text: If the key shows up somewhere it should not, revoke it in the console and create a new one—faster and safer than investigating who saw it.

modules.title: What it is not
modules.text: API keys and auth tokens can both authenticate program calls. Their names, lifetimes, and permission scopes depend on the service, so the label alone does not make one temporary or safe. Neither belongs in a git repository or chat log. Tell the AI: 'Read the key from an environment variable and only reference the variable name.'

distinctions.label: Authentication
distinctions.text: {c:authentication} verifies a human signing in; {c:api-key} authenticates a program's call to a service.

distinctions.label: Env Var
distinctions.text: {c:env-var} is where the key value lives; {c:api-key} is the credential itself.
